Privacy Policy

Last updated: July 6, 2026

This privacy policy explains how the website hosted at jdools.com (the "Site") is operated. The Site is a static portfolio showcasing personal projects, owned and maintained by Jordan Dooley.

Information Collection

The Site is a static website. We do not collect, store, or process any personal information from visitors. There is no registration, no contact forms, no user accounts, and no newsletter subscription on the Site.

Cookies and Tracking

The Site does not use cookies, pixel tags, or any third-party analytics or tracking scripts. No profiling occurs and no data is sold or shared with external parties.

Third-Party Links

The Site contains links to other websites and external services (including social media platforms such as LinkedIn and GitHub, and hosted applications). Clicking those links redirects you to third-party sites that have their own privacy policies. We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of those external sites.

Embedded Content

Any embedded content (such as images or media) behaves the same way as if the visitor had visited the third-party website that provided the content. Third-party hosts may collect data, use cookies, embed additional media, and monitor your interaction with that content.

Data Security

Because no personal data is collected, there is no data to secure. The Site is served over HTTPS to protect the integrity of the content delivered to visitors.

Changes to This Policy

We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Any changes will be reflected by updating the "Last updated" date at the top of this page.

Contact

If you have any questions about this privacy policy, you can reach the site operator through the links on the main page.
